info.title: Law firm consultation booking API
info.description: Draft client-facing contract for an immigration-focused law firm, without city-specific positioning or production defaults. Not frozen or implemented. Staff/admin operations, lawyer roster administration, refund actions and operational tooling require a separate contract increment before launch. No property valuation, document uploads, or automated legal advice. Names, prices, currency support, consultation modes and firm policies need confirmation. All examples are synthetic; no quoted price is a business commitment. HTTPS required in deployment. API responses containing session, intake, booking or payment data use Cache-Control: no-store. Record ownership and staff permissions are enforced server-side, independent of frontend route guards.

servers.description: Relative draft base; configure environment origin and allowed credentialed browser origins at implementation.

get.description: Public bootstrap for login/registration and other mutations. Bind token to anonymous/session cookie context; use no-store and explicit allowed origins. Fetch again when the session rotates or the token expires.

post.description: Creates an unverified client when eligible and schedules verification email. Always return the same generic accepted response for existing/unknown accounts. Role is assigned server-side; no authenticated session until login.
Consumes a single-use verification token. Does not sign the client in automatically.
Generic response whether the address is unknown, verified, or pending verification; throttle delivery.
Use a generic invalid-credentials error. Rotate session/CSRF identifiers on success. Unverified accounts may view their profile but booking creation returns 403 until verified.

Requires a valid CSRF context and is repeatable even after the session has expired. Invalidate the server session and clear cookies. A valid authenticated session is not required and 401 is intentionally omitted; obtain a fresh anonymous CSRF context if needed.
Return a generic accepted response and schedule a reset email only where eligible; never disclose account existence.
Consumes the reset token, changes the password and revokes existing sessions. Requires a subsequent login.

patch.description: Reject role, email, IDs and other server-owned fields. Null phone removes the optional number.

get.description: The route retains the term topics; each entry represents a firm-approved service. Only enabled services and approved jurisdiction/language/mode/pricing options are public.

Offers are not reservations. Server applies roster eligibility, local-office schedules, holidays, buffer times, lead-time rules and DST. Require from < to and enforce a configured maximum search horizon. Offers are bound to the requested language and consultationMode; booking creation must match those selections.

parameters.name: durationMinutes
parameters.description: One duration supported by the selected service.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Requested consultation language; eligibility filters the assigned lawyer.

parameters.name: consultationMode
parameters.description: Requested appointment mode; eligibility is checked for service and lawyer.

parameters.name: timeZone
parameters.description: Client display timezone; does not change UTC interval meaning.

post.summary: Reserve a consultation with a payment hold
post.description: Verified clients only. Atomically recheck slot eligibility and all overlapping lawyer intervals, assign the slot's lawyer, persist a server-priced quote, and create pendingPayment with hold expiry. Do not accept client IDs, prices or status. An offer alone does not secure a slot.

get.description: Server filters ownership before pagination; no staff-wide listing is implied by this endpoint.

get.summary: Read an owned booking and authoritative status
get.description: Ownership enforced for every request. Client reads this state after provider SDK completion instead of assuming payment succeeded.

put.description: Owner only; permitted before the configured intake cutoff on pendingPayment or confirmed bookings. Replaces the minimal intake payload. Record versioned consent actor/time server-side. No uploads, identity documents or legal advice are accepted by this contract.

example.summary: Consulta inicial sobre un servicio migratorio anunciado por el despacho.

get.summary: Read the owner's saved intake for resume/prefill
get.description: Account owner only, independently enforced for this sensitive endpoint. Return data:null when no intake has been saved, 404 for a missing/inaccessible booking. Send Cache-Control:no-store and do not log the response.

post.summary: Create or reuse the booking's PaymentIntent
post.description: Owner and verified email required. Booking must remain pendingPayment with an active hold, current version, completed required intake and any configured screening satisfied. Use the server quote and reuse a compatible provider intent; never charge from browser-supplied amounts. No confirmation until verified provider state is processed.

Apply the firm's configured cancellation cutoff and refund policy; no policy is established by this draft. Coordinate cancellation with payment/webhook races and release the appointment interval transactionally. Refund status is independent from booking status. Replay the same idempotency key safely.

post.summary: Durably receive a signed Stripe event
post.description: Provider-to-server endpoint; exempt from cookie/CSRF checks, not from signature verification. Verify Stripe-Signature against the raw request bytes, timestamp tolerance, configured endpoint secret and intended account/environment. Persist event ID uniquely before 200, then process idempotently. Reject invalid signatures with 400; return 503 when durable acceptance fails. Duplicate accepted events return 200. Out-of-order or late success must not bypass booking conflicts/expiry; reconcile or send to an operational exception/refund workflow.

get.summary: Read an approved public lawyer summary
get.description: Resolve lawyerId from an availability offer or booking to display the firm's approved professional name, credentials and languages. Only public approved profiles are returned.

cookieSession.name: session
cookieSession.description: Opaque server session in an HttpOnly, Secure cookie. No bearer tokens in browser storage. SameSite and CORS policy must match deployment origins.

csrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfHeader.description: Required on every browser mutation including registration/login/logout/recovery. Obtain via GET /v1/csrf and refresh after session rotation. Independently validate the allowed request origin.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated key scoped to authenticated principal and operation; same key/body replays the original result, conflicting body returns 409.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the preceding list response.

Error400.description: Malformed request, invalid cursor, expired/invalid verification token, or invalid webhook signature.

Error403.description: CSRF validation failed, email verification required, or action is not permitted.

Error404.description: Resource not found or not visible to the authenticated principal; ownership must not be disclosed.

Error409.description: Slot conflict, stale booking version, invalid state transition, or idempotency key reused with a different body.

error.message: The selected appointment is no longer available.

Error422.description: Field validation failed, unsupported service/duration/locale/mode combination, or business policy prohibits the action.

Error429.description: Rate limit exceeded. Retry-After indicates the retry delay.

Retry-After.description: Seconds before another attempt when available.

Error503.description: Temporary dependency or service failure. Retry safely using the original idempotency key where required.

Retry-After.description: Seconds before another attempt when available.

Acknowledged.description: Accepted. Authentication/recovery flows use a generic response to avoid account enumeration.

Session.description: Session established. Set an HttpOnly, Secure cookie and rotate CSRF/session identifiers; do not return a bearer token.

Set-Cookie.description: Session cookie; SameSite policy and allowed credentialed origins must be configured together.

UtcInstant.description: Valid RFC 3339 UTC instant ending in Z, with seconds and optional fractional seconds. Offset-form inputs must be converted to UTC by the client; server validates calendar/time values in addition to this pattern.

TimeZone.description: Valid IANA timezone validated by the server. Each office/lawyer schedule requires an explicitly configured timezone; there is no location-based production default. The example is synthetic. UTC offsets alone are not accepted.

Currency.description: Lowercase three-letter ISO 4217 currency code; the server accepts only firm-configured currencies supported by the payment provider. Syntax alone does not imply a valid or enabled currency. Examples are synthetic, not production defaults. Use the currency-specific minor-unit scale.

requestId.description: Correlation identifier without confidential matter details.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor; null when there are no more results.

csrfToken.description: CSRF token bound to the anonymous/session context. Hold in memory; do not log.

phone.description: E.164 format if supplied; never infer country from office location.

csrfToken.description: New CSRF token after authentication/session rotation.

password.description: Password policy is enforced server-side; example minimum is a draft policy.

token.description: Single-use, expiring verification token; never log.
Single-use, expiring reset token; never log.

ProfilePatch.description: Email and role cannot be changed through this endpoint.

amount.description: Integer minor units; never floating-point major-unit amounts.

items.description: Firm-approved jurisdiction label; immigration services do not imply authorization in an unspecified jurisdiction.

expiresAt.description: Expiry of this availability offer, not a reservation. Booking creation rechecks conflicts and eligibility.

Quote.description: Server-issued immutable booking price snapshot in integer minor units; total = subtotal + tax. Tax treatment is configured, not assumed.

holdExpiresAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant; serialize with Z.

resolutionRequired.description: True when late payment, refund failure or another payment/booking mismatch needs staff resolution. Client UI must show a pending-resolution message, not assume an appointment is confirmed.

Booking.description: Customer-safe booking view. Does not include legal intake text, private lawyer notes or other customers' information. Status is authoritative server state.

ConsentInput.description: Acceptance of configured notice versions for this workflow; server records actor/time. Marketing consent is not bundled.

summary.description: Optional brief consultation purpose, not a full case file. Plain text; avoid unnecessary sensitive identifiers.

IntakeReceipt.description: Acknowledges persistence without echoing confidential intake.

PaymentIntentRequest.description: No price, currency, customer ID or Stripe secret is accepted from the client.

clientSecret.description: Sensitive provider client secret for this owner/booking only. Never log, cache publicly, or persist in URLs.

PaymentIntent.description: Creates or reuses a compatible PaymentIntent for the active booking. SDK completion is not proof that the booking is confirmed.

reason.description: Optional plain-text cancellation reason; avoid case details.

StripeEvent.description: Provider event envelope only; verify the raw, unmodified body signature and supported Stripe API version before processing.

summary.description: Optional brief consultation purpose, not a full case file. Plain text; avoid unnecessary sensitive identifiers.

SavedIntake.description: Owner's current saved intake; null when none exists. Sensitive: Cache-Control no-store. Previously accepted notice versions are metadata, not automatic acceptance of a new notice.

LawyerSummary.description: Firm-approved public professional profile only; no private account contacts, schedules or internal case data. The firm verifies credentials and permitted jurisdictions before publication.
